findings.issue: IEEE_FMA plans used only cases where fused and unfused results agree
findings.resolution: binary-guarded t = 2^-k with p+1 <= 2k <= 2(p-2) (k = 13 for p = 24, 27 for p = 53): IEEE_FMA(1+t, 1+t, -(1+2t)) == t*t, which an unfused multiply loses

findings.issue: IEEE_COPY_SIGN lacked mixed-kind and signed-zero magnitude cases
findings.resolution: mixed-kind X/Y with the kind of X; constructed, pre-verified signed zeros, infinities; NaN sign no-oracle (no signed NaN class)

findings.issue: IEEE_GET_MODES round trips could be vacuous when the saved state already equalled the forced state
findings.resolution: each component is set to a different value first

findings.issue: the RADIX=10 rounding-mode plan was unguarded and only checked set membership
findings.resolution: guarded decimal support and the exact mode after IEEE_SET_ROUNDING_MODE

findings.issue: reopened: the halting component was set to .NOT. h0 but the change was never observed before IEEE_SET_MODES(saved)
findings.resolution: IEEE_GET_HALTING_MODE confirms .NOT. h0 before restore, then h0 after; no signaling operation while halting may be .TRUE.
